8.3.13 V2xM_CalcHeadingInTolerance
[SWS_V2xM_00178] Definition of API function V2xM_CalcHeadingInTolerance ⌈
Service Name
V2xM_CalcHeadingInTolerance
Syntax
boolean V2xM_CalcHeadingInTolerance (
float32 Heading1,
float32 Heading2,
float32 Tolerance
)
Service ID [hex]
0x0f
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Heading1
First heading value
Heading2
Second heading value
Parameters (in)
Tolerance
Allowed tolerance between heading values
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
boolean
TRUE: diff of headings is within tolerance
FALSE: diff of headings is outside tolerance
Description
Calculates if difference of heading values are within a tolerance value
Available via
V2xM.h
⌋
